graph.window_mask: prior measured-interval ledger reverified against source; missing electrodes excluded before connectivity
graph.cache_rejection: Nonzero cached adjacency failed all-window measured raw reconstruction parity; no consistent audited construction provenance; not claimed to be fabricated
graph.eigenvector: unit L2 nonnegative principal vector via scipy.linalg.eigh; tied dominant eigenvalues within 1e-10*max(1,lambda) => NaN explicit unidentifiable; no-edge graph => defined zero convention; solver failures block
graph.pagerank: weighted .85 damping; uniform start/teleport and dangling redistribution; original n*1e-6 L1 convergence and max100 iterations; nonconvergence blocks
graph.local_efficiency: neighbor induced graph, reciprocal weight distance with 1e-8 floor; mean reciprocal shortest path over reachable ordered pairs, matching repository; SciPy Floyd-Warshall exact algorithm
graph.schema: seven window means then seven population stds, equal-seizure nan-aware mean; temporal strength change/max(dt,1); pairwise rank stability
graph.strength_rank: average tie rank mapped (rank-1)/(C-1); singleton .5; stability missing unless >=2 observed seizures
graph.missing: preserved NaN; only FIT-fitted imputation; no fake single-seizure stability
graph.degenerate_stop: more than8 dimensions with no finite between-channel variation in >50% of original patients or <5% finite rows

preprocessing.original88: bitwise original D2 frozen banks, no refit
preprocessing.graph16: unlabeled per-patient nanmean/nanstd z-score with 1e-8 floor; FIT SimpleImputer(mean) then FIT StandardScaler, dimension104 invariant; entirely missing FIT dimension blocks
preprocessing.G2: stable seed42 cyclic derangement within identical valid-seizure availability signatures; complete16 vectors and missingness together; before population fitting; patient-wise z-score commutes with permutation
preprocessing.G3: exact zeros for16 additional positions after graph preprocessing; not a full feature-dependent capacity control

model.initialization: fresh original SourceA0 initializer; seed42+1009*fold; all3 identical state hash; dedicated V generator42+7000+seed; no D2 warm start

training.objective: NEZ-positive weighted mean BCE within patient; FIT EZcount/NEZcount pos_weight; one update/patient
training.order: sorted original FIT patient groups, default_rng(seed+epoch).permutation; same dropout reseed original trainer
training.device: cuda float32; no AMP/TF32; original audited runtime312
training.resume: exact epoch-boundary model/Adam/dropout/CPU+CUDA RNG and history, SHA-bound code/data/protocol

evaluation.intervention: G1 graph16=>neutral0 at same selected threshold without retraining; not D2
evaluation.ranking: canonical channel stable sort before exact original metric

gate.measurably_used: patient-equal mean abs NEZ probability change on neutralization >1e-6 AND any ranking or thresholded decision change

terminal_priority: GRAPH_INFORMATION_DEGENERATE before training if >8 structurally unidentifiable dimensions
